listenQuestion: What would have happened if only two of the sixteen water-tight

lines.zh: 巨轮“泰坦尼克”号1912年4月10日从南安普敦起锚驶向纽约。

lines.en: The great ship, Titanic, sailed for New York from Southampton on April 10th, 1912.
lines.zh: 船上载有1,316名乘客与891名船员。

lines.en: She was carrying 1,316 passengers and crew of 891.
lines.zh: 却使用现代标准来衡量，45,000吨的“泰坦尼克”号与算得上一艘巨轮了。

lines.en: Even by modern standards, the 46,000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship.
lines.zh: 当时，这艘轮船不仅是造船史上建造的最大的一艘船，而且也被认为是不会沉没的。

lines.en: At the time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen watertight compartments.
lines.zh: 因为船由16个密封舱组成，即使有两个舱进水，仍可漂浮的水面上。

lines.en: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
lines.zh: 然而，这艘巨轮首航就下沉，造成大批人员死亡。

lines.en: The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
lines.zh: 人们将永远记着这艘巨轮的沉没惨剧。

lines.en: Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy water of the North Atlantic, huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout .
lines.zh: “泰坦尼克”起航后的第4天，它正行驶在北大西洋冰冷的海面上。

lines.en: After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.
lines.zh: 突然，了望员发现一座冰山。警报响过不久，巨轮急转弯，以避免与冰山正面相撞。

lines.en: The Titanic turned just in time, narrowly missing the immense walk of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her.
lines.zh: “泰坦尼克”这个弯拐得及时，紧贴着高出海面100英尺的巨大的冰墙擦过去。

lines.en: Suddenly, there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down to see what had happened.
lines.zh: 突然，从船舱下部传来一声微颤音，船长走下船舱去查看究竟。

lines.en: The noise had been so faint that no one though that the ship had been damaged.
lines.zh: 由于这个声音非常轻，没人会想到船身已遭损坏。

lines.en: Below, the captain realized to his horror that the Titanic was sinking rapidly, for five of her sixteen watertight compartments had already been flooded!
lines.zh: 在下面，船长惊恐的地发现“泰坦尼克”号正在急速下沉，16个密封舱已有5个进水。

lines.en: The order to abandon ship was given and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water.
lines.zh: 于是，他发出弃船的命令，几百人跳进了冰冷刺骨的海水里。

lines.en: As there were not enough lifeboats for everybody, 1,500 lives were lost.
lines.zh: 由于没有足够的救生艇运载所有乘客，结果，1,500人丧生。

rawNotes.grammar:
1  sail for，驶往……。
2  even by modern standards，即使依照现代标准来衡量。by作“依照”、“按照”讲。
3  regarded as unsinkable，被认为是不会沉没的。  regard… as…当“把……当作……”讲。
4  she  went down  on  her first voyage  with  heavy loss  of life，她首航就下沉，造成大批人员死亡。go  down是“下沉”的意思。
5  narrowly missing，勉强避开。
6  Below, the captain realized to his horror，在下面，船长惊恐地发现。  below是个副词。
